g.text: Walk me through CVE-2024-3094 — what's the exploitation path and how would I detect a compromised host?
Considering CVE-2024-3094 supply-chain backdoor in xz-utils. The malicious liblzma replaces an IFUNC
resolver and hooks RSA_public_decrypt in sshd. Detection vector: anomalous RSA cert in sshd memory; YARA
CVE-2024-3094 is a supply-chain backdoor in xz-utils 5.6.0 and 5.6.1. The malicious liblzma replaces an IFUNC
resolver and hooks RSA_public_decrypt in sshd, letting a remote attacker holding the matching private key
Detection: (1) check xz --version on every host — anything ≥5.6.0 and <5.6.2 is suspect; (2) hash
liblzma.so.5 against known-good; (3) YARA on the IFUNC resolver pattern; (4) audit sshd memory for the
▸ ENTER send ▸ SHIFT+ENTER newline ▸ F2 THINK ▸ F3 RAG ▸ F4 CTX ▸ F5 TOPK ▸ /help ▸ CTRL+C/D exit
